summary: Bioceres Crop Solutions filed a Form 6-K disclosing that on September 18, 2026, the Supreme Court of New York (Schecter, J.) granted plaintiffs' summary judgment motion on damages in Jasper Lake Ventures One LLC, et al. v. Bioceres Crop Solutions Corp., Index No. 659704/2025. Damages were awarded per plaintiffs' motion papers, plus per diem interest from July 23, 2026 until judgment entry and $1.4 million in costs and attorneys' fees, joint and several against all defendants. Bioceres and the Guarantor Defendants intend to appeal. Watch appeal timing, stay, and any collateral or liquidity impact.
